summary: TransAct Technologies filed an 8-K announcing the appointment of Troy W. Ingianni as CFO, Secretary and Treasurer effective July 1, 2026, following the planned retirement of Steven A. DeMartino and the declination of the role by Controller Robert Campbell. The filing details Mr. Ingianni's extensive financial reporting and SEC compliance experience at Barnes Group Inc. and Deloitte. No financial terms, premiums, or deal mechanics are involved. This is a routine executive succession event with no special-situation implications. What to watch: any further management turnover or strategic shifts under the new CFO.
